title: Call center metric distortion
observations: Agents are rewarded for short handle time.
Repeat calls increased after the target was tightened.
Agents transfer complex calls near the target threshold.
Quality scores are reviewed less frequently than speed scores.
participant_claims: Managers say some agents do not care enough about customers.
researcher_interpretations: The performance system may reward behavior that increases total demand.
missing_evidence: Repeat-contact rate by agent and call type.
